features.title: Understand before you trust
features.warningText: Identify pressure tactics, guaranteed returns, suspicious requests, and other potential warning signs.
features.evidenceText: See the exact phrases that deserve closer attention and understand why they matter.
features.nextText: Find safer actions and relevant official investor-protection resources.

privacy.title: Privacy & Safety Principles
privacy.short: Submitted messages are processed strictly in-memory for analysis and are not saved.
privacy.detail1: Do not enter passwords, OTPs, or banking credentials.
privacy.detail2: Messages are analyzed in real-time and not stored by NiveshShield.
privacy.detail3: API keys remain securely on the backend server.
privacy.detail4: Designed around data minimization and investor safety.

targetMetric.title: Target Evaluation Metric
targetMetric.text: Target evaluation metric: ≥90% recall on reviewed synthetic test cases for predefined critical warning indicators, measured separately across all 6 supported languages.

disclaimer: NiveshShield provides educational safety guidance. It does not provide financial advice or a definitive fraud verdict.
emptyMessage: Paste a message before checking it.

analysis.title: Safety check
analysis.review: This does not confirm that the message is safe. Verify the sender, claims and organization independently before taking action.
analysis.noWarningNoticeText: No specific warning signs were identified from the submitted text. However, this does NOT confirm that the message or investment is safe. Always verify the sender, credentials, and regulatory registration independently.
analysis.impersonation: Suspicious claim of identity or official affiliation
analysis.unofficialApp: Request to download an unofficial app or APK
analysis.genericWarning: This message contains language that deserves additional verification.
analysis.unknownsTitle: What could not be verified from this message
analysis.safetyText: We look for warning signs and supporting evidence — we never recommend investments or predict returns.
analysis.noFindings: No specific warning signs were identified from the submitted message.

incident.title: What happened?
incident.description: Select your situation for relevant safety guidance and immediate action steps.
incident.notSentDescription: I received the message but haven't transferred any funds.
incident.sentMoneyDescription: I have transferred funds or made a payment.
incident.installedApp: I installed an app / opened a link
incident.installedAppDescription: I interacted with an APK, app, or suspicious web link.
incident.notSentStep1: Do not send money, OTPs, passwords, or account credentials.
incident.notSentStep2: Verify the sender and organization using an independent official source.
incident.notSentStep3: Avoid installing apps or opening links until independently verified.
incident.sentMoneyTitle: Act quickly to report & preserve evidence
incident.sentMoneyStep1: Contact your bank or payment provider immediately through its official channel.
incident.sentMoneyStep2: Preserve transaction details, chat logs, UPI IDs, and evidence.
incident.sentMoneyStep3: Report suspected cyber financial fraud through the official cybercrime reporting portal.
incident.installedAppStep1: Do not enter passwords, OTPs, or banking credentials into the app or website.
incident.installedAppStep2: Avoid granting additional permissions to untrusted apps.
incident.installedAppStep3: If sensitive information was entered, contact your bank/service provider immediately.
incident.installedAppStep4: Report financial loss or cybercrime to the official Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
